description: - Specifications:  - Material: food grade paper. - Size: height is 1.81 inches, 1.91 inches of the bottom diameter, 2.3 inches of the top diameter. - Package: 50 pcs cylindrical box for food. - Plastic container keeps baking cups shape and provides easy storage. - For Kids: not only for decorate cupcake, also decorate any place, like garden, home, bedroom, office, thanksgiving day, christmas eve.. Methods of use: place the cups on the baking mould and pour the finely mixed cake ingredients into the cups ensuring the amount of cake liquid less than 70% of cup capacity; bake for 15 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius. Cautions: no direct exposure to fire and not suitable for cooking; no water or oils are allowed in the cup mould; the highest baking temperature should be not more than 250 degrees Celsius and the baking time should not be too long to avoid damage to the cups and food.
